label: PALDEA
arrive: Porto Marinada: an auction every afternoon, and fishing boats painted every colour there is. The warehouse is behind the auction house.
{brought} squints at the noise. "They're bidding on everything, Boss. Even the fish that got away."
Somebody at the Academy has posted a notice: a "Treasure Hunt" for every student. Half the region is out on the roads, and nobody is watching the shops.

owner.name: The neighbours
owner.line: A tiny town on a cape. Everyone knows the Champion's cousin.

owner.name: Trainers on the path
owner.line: The lighthouse at the end is always open.

owner.name: Nobody
owner.line: A cave on the beach. Something big sleeps in it.

owner.name: The vice principal
owner.line: Five hundred students and one very tired head teacher.

owner.name: The plaza crowd
owner.line: Cafés round a fountain, and every student's parents.

owner.name: Officer Jenny
owner.line: She knows every student by name.

owner.name: The auctioneer
owner.line: Everything goes under the hammer, nothing has papers.

owner.name: The fishermen
owner.line: Boats of every colour, catches of every kind.

owner.name: The fishmonger
owner.line: Fresh in at dawn, sold by noon.

owner.name: The stream crew
owner.line: Every move is filmed. Every film gets a million views.

owner.name: The mall manager
owner.line: Neon signs and a tower of screens.

owner.name: Beach crowds
owner.line: Neon by night, sand by day.

owner.name: The stall owners
owner.line: A city on a waterfall, a market on every step.

owner.name: Desert guides
owner.line: Dunes, ruins and missing Trainers.

owner.name: The tourists
owner.line: Everyone takes a picture at the falls.

owner.name: The cook
owner.line: The best food in Paldea. The Gym Leader works here.

owner.name: The diners
owner.line: A town that eats lunch for three hours.

owner.name: Trainers on the route
owner.line: Long roads between towns.

owner.name: The cave keepers
owner.line: Quiet caves, quiet people.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Sells Moon Stones to people who already have three.

owner.name: The meditators
owner.line: Everyone is calm. It's unnerving.

owner.name: The fans
owner.line: A rapper Gym Leader and a frozen crowd.

owner.name: Ski crews
owner.line: The biggest mountain in Paldea, and the coldest.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Hot chocolate and Ice Heals.

owner.name: The research machine
owner.line: Doors that open only for the right voice.

owner.name: Expedition crews
owner.line: The edge of the Great Crater. Nobody goes down.

owner.name: The camp crew
owner.line: Tents at the Gate, waiting for the Academy's say-so.

owner.name: The quarry crew
owner.line: Cliffs, dust and Nacli everywhere.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Sells rope and helmets to climbers.

owner.name: Climbers
owner.line: A town on a cliff, joined by rope bridges.

business.name: The Auction House
business.text: Every lot washes a little: ₽200 a week comes back clean.

business.name: Iono's Studio
business.text: The Hero watches the stream. And the stream watches the Hero.

business.name: Cascarrafa Market
business.text: Cash stalls: ₽150 a week comes back clean.

business.name: Treasure Eatery
business.text: The lunch crowd pays ₽300 a week.

business.name: Zapapico Mart
business.text: Good rope: +5% on jobs in Zapapico.

business.name: Montenevera Mart
business.text: Snowed in: Heat −1 in Montenevera each week.

writers.name: Olive farmer Pepa
writers.quote: {first} picked olives for us. Never once rolled one.

writers.name: Artazon gardener Brassius's aide
writers.quote: {first} trimmed the Sunflora statues. Patient work.

writers.name: Levincia streamer's manager
writers.quote: {first} ran cameras for the streams. Knows what sells.

writers.name: Cascarrafa market seller
writers.quote: {first} worked the bidding hall. Reads people like price tags.

writers.name: Medali restaurant cook
writers.quote: {first} cooked at the Treasure Eatery. Kept the secret menu secret.

writers.name: Academy janitor Kai
writers.quote: {first} cleaned the Academy halls. Saw Team Star come and go.
